body: The air feels thick with tension as I stand frozen in front of the refused request slip. My mind racing with the worst-case scenarios, I can barely make out the faint outlines of the building's walls in the dimly lit alley. My fingers instinctively reach for my bag, the one with the essential emergency supplies, and I hastily rummage through it, securing the items I deem most important. A rush of adrenaline courses through my veins, urging me to move, to escape. The thought of remaining near this place, where a single misstep could spell disaster, becomes my driving motivation. With newfound determination, I set off towards the nearest exit, the path of least resistance.
